_note: State education agencies and how each one takes a public records request. Collected 2026-09-29 by reading each agency's own records page. 'route' is how the request actually goes: email, or a web form. 'resident_only' repeats data/states/records-laws.json — those three will refuse an out-of-state requester and need the Exchange.

OK.note: Portal is Awareity, but the page names this address for requests and status. Fees possible per their schedule.

KY.note: Official records custodian contacts on the department's own open-records page.

SC.note: Also runs a NextRequest portal at scdoe.nextrequest.com; the address is simpler and is theirs.

TX.note: Texas is already complete in the record; this one is for the contact list and the discipline data, not the policies.

AR.note: Arkansas answers its own residents only. Anthony is not one; this needs the Exchange or a Missouri-to-Arkansas proxy.

MO.dept: Missouri Department of Elementary and Secondary Education
MO.note: No dedicated records address published; the Sunshine Law custodian request goes to the general office. Anthony is a Missouri resident, which is worth saying in the request.

MS.statute: the Mississippi Public Records Act, Miss. Code § 25-61-1
MS.note: Page says: complete the PDF form and return it to the Office of Public Reporting by email, fax, or mail; response in 7 days. Phone 601-359-3857. Mail: Office of Public Reporting, MDE, P.O. Box 771, Jackson MS 39205-0771. Attach the filled PDF or paste the same fields in the body. 2026-10-09.

IN.statute: the Indiana Access to Public Records Act, Ind. Code § 5-14-3
IN.note: Official route is the AccessGov APRA portal, which requires an account login to start a form. The portal home page names publicrecords@doe.in.gov for questions; send there. 2026-10-09.

KS.note: Site blocks automated fetches; the form itself opens in a browser.

GA.statute: the Georgia Open Records Act, O.C.G.A. § 50-18-70
GA.note: No web form; page says file by email or postal mail, handled by GaDOE Legal Services. 2026-10-09.

NC.dept: North Carolina Department of Public Instruction

FL.note: No web form; page says call 850-245-9759 or email PRR@fldoe.org. Mail: Attn. Public Records, 325 W. Gaines St, Suite 1544, Tallahassee FL 32399. 2026-10-09.

LA.statute: the Louisiana Public Records Law, La. R.S. 44:1 et seq.
LA.note: Contact page: 'complete the public records request form and submit it to ldepublicrecords@la.gov'. Custodian is State Superintendent Cade Brumley. Attach the PDF form (filled) to the email or paste the same fields in the body. Media requests go to Ted Beasley, ted.beasley@la.gov (not us). 2026-10-09.

WY.statute: the Wyoming Public Records Act, Wyo. Stat. § 16-4-201
WY.note: WDE publishes no records page; only a 600-char general contact form. The statewide Designated Public Records Person list (A&I, ai.wyo.gov/about-us/transparency/public-records -> Data Studio dashboard, updated 2026-10-09) lists WDE's designee as Nathan Tedjeske (Chief Innovation Officer), 307-777-8715, 122 W. 25th St., Ste. E200, Cheyenne WY 82002. Fallback: askthesuperintendent@wyo.gov. 2026-10-09.
